scale.expression: local S={5.12,6.00,161.34,162.26,57.45,59.75,184.45,186.75}; for i=1,#S,2 do if time>=S[i] and time<S[i+1] then local k=math.sin(math.pi*(time-S[i])/(S[i+1]-S[i])); return Vec.v2(value.x*(1-0.06*k), value.y*(1+0.14*k)) end end; local s=0; if time>=45.50 and time<135.50 then s=45.50 end; if time>=172.50 and time<262.50 then s=172.50 end; if (time>=45.50 and time<135.50) or (time>=172.50 and time<262.50) then local b=math.abs(math.sin(math.pi*(time-s)/0.6)); return Vec.v2(value.x*(1+0.04*(1-b)), value.y*(1-0.04*(1-b))) end; return value

position.expression: if time<4.7 then return value end; local s=0; if time>=45.50 and time<135.50 then s=45.50 end; if time>=172.50 and time<262.50 then s=172.50 end; if (time>=45.50 and time<135.50) or (time>=172.50 and time<262.50) then local b=math.abs(math.sin(math.pi*(time-s)/0.6)); return value+Vec.v2(0,-45*b) else return value+Vec.v2(0,-10*math.sin(2*math.pi*time/1.6)) end

rotation.expression: if time<4.5 then return value end; local r=value+4*math.sin(2*math.pi*time/2.4); if time>=34.02 and time<34.82 then r=r+10*math.sin(time*45) end; if time>=23.94 and time<26.74 then r=r-9*math.sin(math.pi*(time-23.94)/2.80) end; if time>=275.25 and time<278.46 then r=r+12*math.sin(time*10) end; return r

scale.expression: local b=0; local C={5.12,6.00,161.34,162.26,278.46,279.06,0.00,0.90}; for i=1,#C,2 do if time>=C[i] and time<C[i+1] then b=1 end end; local p=(time+0.7)%3.9; local k=0; if p<0.08 then k=p/0.08 elseif p<0.13 then k=1 elseif p<0.21 then k=(0.21-p)/0.08 end; if b==1 then k=1 end; return Vec.v2(0.8194,0.8194*k)

opacity.expression: local b=0; local C={5.12,6.00,161.34,162.26,278.46,279.06,0.00,0.90}; for i=1,#C,2 do if time>=C[i] and time<C[i+1] then b=1 end end; local p=(time+0.7)%3.9; local k=0; if p<0.08 then k=p/0.08 elseif p<0.13 then k=1 elseif p<0.21 then k=(0.21-p)/0.08 end; if b==1 then k=1 end; if k>0.85 then return 1 end; return 0
